transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Stop where you stand. Your boots scrape the stone louder than you think.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I'm looking for my brother Omar. The cursed well dragged him down here.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Lower your voice. Anger travels farther than footsteps in this place.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Then stop wasting my time and help me. You're the only person I've seen down here.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Paths are not gifts I hand to strangers. Tell me why the well took your brother.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Because I dared him to insult it. Now quit talking in circles and tell me where he is.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Careful with that tone. The well enjoys careless mouths.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Oh spare me the creepy cave wisdom. Are you going to help or just sit there pretending to be important?

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Mind how you speak, boy. Pride breaks quicker than bone down here.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: You're an old man sitting next to a fountain doing nothing. Don't lecture me.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: I have survived here longer than you have been alive. That should tell you something.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Yeah, it tells me you're good at hiding and talking nonsense.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Your brother fell because of a foolish dare. Do not let your tongue drag you down after him.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: If you know so much, then prove it. Tell me how to survive down there.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Fear feeds the well and thins your memory. Stand steady or you will forget the very reason you came.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: More riddles. Is that all you know how to do?

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: There are words that steady a man before the King of Jinn. They are not spoken lightly.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Then stop acting mysterious and just tell me the words already.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Strength is not given to those who demand it like a spoiled child.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: You talk big for someone who just sits here all day.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Sacred things do not belong in the mouths of the disrespectful.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Disrespectful? You're the most useless guide I've ever seen.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Enough. A boy who spits insults cannot carry sacred words. Those words are not meant for cruel tongues — go find your own path, because I will not give them to you.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: So you're just going to sit there and do nothing?

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Yes. You have shown me what kind of boy you are.
